title: capesR
text: capesR package developed facilitate access manipulation data Catalog Theses Dissertations Brazilian Coordination Improvement Higher Education Personnel (CAPES). catalog includes information theses dissertations defended higher education institutions Brazil, variables : institution (ies): Higher Education Institution. area (area): Evaluation area graduate program. knowledge areas (grande_area, area_conhecimento, subarea, especialidade, CAPES code cd_*, area_concentracao): CAPES classification work. Subarea, specialty concentration area published 2013 onwards. region state (regiao, uf): Location institution. abstract (resumo): Brief description topic objectives. full list columns ?read_capes_data. package automates process obtaining organizing data, making easily accessible analysis reporting. original CAPES data available dadosabertos.capes.gov.br. yearly Parquet files used package hosted Hugging Face. file index, URLs checksums, shipped package capes_years.

title: capesR
text: install package, use:
code: install.packages("capesR") # or the development version: devtools::install_github("StrategicProjects/capesR")

title: capesR
text: download_capes_data function downloads yearly CAPES data files. can specify desired years, corresponding files saved locally. use mirror, set options(capesR.base_url = "https://.mirror/path") pass base_url = directly.

title: capesR
text: Download data using temporary directory (function default): case, data persist future uses.
code: library(capesR) library(dplyr)  # Download data for 1987 and 1990 capes_files <- download_capes_data(c(1987, 1990))  # View the list of downloaded files capes_files %>% glimpse()

title: capesR
text: recommended define persistent directory store downloaded data instead using default temporary directory (tempdir()). allow reuse data future. using persistent directory, data downloaded . future uses, function identify files already exist directory return paths.

title: capesR 0.3.0
text: New columns CAPES knowledge-area classification, names codes: grande_area, cd_grande_area, area_conhecimento, cd_area_conhecimento, subarea, cd_subarea, especialidade, cd_especialidade area_concentracao (#9). 12 existing columns keep names position. CAPES publish subarea, specialty concentration area 1987-2012, NA years. columns documented ?read_capes_data. Breaking change data: area now evaluation area (área de avaliação) every year. files 1987-2012 used hold knowledge area, unlike 2013 onwards; value now area_conhecimento. Code filters area years 2012 get different results. years rebuilt XLSX files CAPES open data portal. Curly quotes, dashes similar characters stored invisible control characters titles abstracts 2013, 2019 2021-2024 now correct. 2017, 2018 2020 now follow files CAPES revised August 2024: 15 records (4 2017, 11 2018), typographic quotes dashes titles abstracts replaced plain equivalents, source. new files served separate folder data repository, earlier versions package keep working files expect. download_capes_data() downloads file copy found destination expected size, e.g. file saved earlier version package. Previously existing file reused.

title: capesR 0.2.1
text: CRAN release: 2026-10-20 search_capes_text() accepts several terms several fields (#5, hugoavmedeiros/capesR). row kept terms occurs fields, e.g. search_capes_text(data, c("varicela", "catapora"), c("titulo", "resumo")); new match = "" argument requires every term instead. Previously vector term raised error. read_capes_data() text filters (titulo, resumo) also accept vector terms, matching rows contain . nothing matches, search_capes_text() returns empty data.frame columns input (previously data.frame columns). Added unit tests (testthat). Repository moved https://github.com/StrategicProjects/capesR, now also holds history original hugoavmedeiros/capesR repository.

title: capesR 0.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-09-20 Data updated CAPES open data portal: years 2023 2024 added, 2019, 2021 2022 replaced revised files CAPES published 2025 (institution names files now use (CAMPUS) instead ( CAMPUS )). package now covers 1987 2024. André Leite now package maintainer (previously Hugo Vasconcelos Medeiros). Data hosting moved OSF. yearly Parquet files now listed new capes_years dataset (year, file, url, bytes, md5), replaces years_osf. download_capes_data() reads URL table, host can change without touching code. download_capes_data() gains base_url argument (default getOption("capesR.base_url")) download mirror, downloads temporary .part file first, checks file size, warns requested years available. read_capes_data() text search now works actual column names data (titulo, resumo); previously recognised title, filters = list(titulo = "...") silently matched nothing. read_capes_data() longer loads whole dataset memory just read column names. Repository moved https://github.com/milkway/capesR.
